fixture_defaults.precedence: Explicit case values and explicit variants override these defaults. No constructor parameter affecting outcomes may be selected by implementation. Integer times are logical UTC nanoseconds, exact int excluding bool. Array price/ratio encodings are converted exactly, never via float.

point_expansion.price_only_path: prices at times1,2,... in array order, sequence0, known_at=at
point_expansion.empty_event_array: No observed events; no invented endpoint point. Certified carried-mark process applies.
point_expansion.unknown_order: Preserve supplied sequence as identity only; source_order_known=false forbids interpreting it as evidence.

observation_window.end: explicit observed_end, otherwise target end, default10
observation_window.gap_convention: [start,end); observations at gap start forbidden and at gap end allowed

legacy_sample.target_version: target-v1, replaced by exact retained target ArtifactRef.sha256 only in actual F11 fixtures

typed_temporal_sample.target_version: target-v1 or exact F11 retained target hash

fixture_defaults.synthetic_provenance: These defaults and capacity variants are engineering fixture choices, not copied source parameter values or new original-reading credit.

finite_limits.record: V01V02LimitsV1 (adjacent new configuration; no legacy dataclass changes)
finite_limits.validation: Every limit exact positive int, bool forbidden; configurable downward or upward only through explicit supplied limits retained with checkpoint/plan configuration. F11 applies min(applicable local limit, existing F11 limit).
finite_limits.enforcement: Check capacity before append/extend, hashing, decoding or recursive allocation; no truncation. All iterable inputs consumed with at most capacity+1 observations; fail closed on one-over. UTF8 bytes are measured on canonical encoding; checkpoint restores enforce supplied limits before parsing and structural limits after bounded parse. Rejected mutation leaves ledger/plan/checkpoint unchanged.
finite_limits.serialization: Checkpoint envelope includes exact limits; restoring under a different supplied limit configuration rejects unless explicitly validating an already decoded immutable snapshot without republishing. Legacy serialization unchanged.
